segments.title: Your iPhone knows when it's FULL
segments.say: Your iPhone can tell you exactly when it'll be fully charged.

segments.title: Settings › Battery
segments.say: Plug it in, open Settings, and tap Battery.

segments.title: Time to 80% and 100%
segments.say: At the top, you'll see the time to eighty percent, and to a hundred. Or to your charge limit.

segments.title: It flashes on the Lock Screen
segments.sub: For **a few seconds** after you plug in
segments.say: It also flashes on the Lock Screen for a few seconds.

segments.title: Needs iOS 26
segments.say: You need iOS twenty six or later.

segments.sub: to the friend who's always at 2%
segments.say: Send this to the friend who's always at two percent.
